suspended.title: Your account is paused
suspended.body: You can't receive or accept jobs right now.
suspended.notice: Our team has suspended this provider account. Contact support to understand why and what you can do next.

application.title: Your application
application.draftIntro: Complete all 9 steps to apply. Your answers are saved after every step, so you can stop and come back any time.
application.infoRequiredTitle: Our reviewer needs a few more details
application.infoRequiredBody: Open the highlighted steps, update them and submit again.

next.one: Our verification team checks your details and documents.
next.two: Each service you offer is approved separately. You may hear from us if anything is unclear.
next.three: Once approved, you will start receiving job invitations from customers near you.

application.autoRefresh: This page updates by itself while we review.
application.rejectedBody: Contact support if you would like to know more.

wizard.readOnly: Your application is with our team, so it can't be changed right now.

personal.title: About you
personal.subtitle: Your name and contact details, as on your ID.

location.title: Where you live
location.subtitle: This helps us match you with customers nearby.

services.title: Services you offer
services.subtitle: Pick every kind of work you want to do. Each one is approved separately.

service_details.title: Rates and details
service_details.subtitle: Your experience and charges for each service.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Tell customers about your work and training.

service_area.title: Work area
service_area.subtitle: How far you are willing to travel for a job.

availability.title: Availability
availability.subtitle: When you can work each week.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Upload proof so we can verify you.

review.title: Review and submit
review.subtitle: Check everything, then send your application.

personal.adultHint: You must be 18 or older to work on Fix60.
personal.whatsappHint: We send job updates here if you allow it.

location.addressNoteHint: Only our verification team can see this.
location.privateNotice: Customers never see your address. They only see your locality.
location.localitiesFailed: We couldn't load localities. Pull down to try again.

serviceDetails.noServices: Pick your services in step 3 first.
serviceDetails.eligibility: This service needs at least {{years}} of experience.
serviceDetails.years: Years of experience in this service
serviceDetails.ratesHint: Fill at least one. Leave the others empty.

experience.bioHint: Customers see this on your profile. Don't add phone numbers.
experience.previousWorkHint: Homes, hospitals or companies you have worked for.
experience.qualificationsHint: Optional. Add courses, certificates or past jobs.

serviceArea.noCentre: Choose your locality in step 2 or use your current location.

locate.denied: Location permission was not given. We'll use your locality instead. You can allow location in your phone settings.
locate.unavailable: We couldn't get your location. Check that location is on and try again.

serviceArea.travel: Will you travel to the customer?

availability.weeklyHint: Turn on the days you work and set your hours.

timeOff.title: Time off
timeOff.hint: You won't get job invitations during these times.

errors.missing: Pick both start and end date and time.
errors.order: The end must be after the start.

documents.title: My documents
documents.screenIntro: Your verification documents and their review status.
documents.privacyBody: Only Fix60 verification staff can view them. Customers never see your documents.
documents.formats: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 5 MB each.

errors.permission: Permission was not given. Allow camera or photos access in your phone settings.
errors.tooLarge: This file is bigger than 5 MB. Take a clearer, smaller photo or choose another file.
errors.badType: Only JPG, PNG or PDF files can be uploaded.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't read this file. Please try another one.

documents.last4Label: Last 4 digits of your ID number
documents.last4Hint: Enter only the last 4 digits. We never store full Aadhaar numbers.
documents.removeBody: {{name}} will be removed. You can upload it again.
documents.extrasBody: Optional. Certificates help customers trust you.

review.declaration: I confirm my details are true and I agree to the provider agreement
review.declarationPrefix: I confirm the details I gave are true and I agree to the
review.successBody: Our team will review your details and documents. We will notify you when you are approved.

jobs.privacyHint: Customer contact details are shared only after a booking is confirmed.
jobs.emptyBody: We'll notify you when a customer nearby needs your service. Keep your availability up to date.

invitation.title: Job invitation
invitation.contactHidden: Phone number and full address are shared only after the customer confirms the booking.
invitation.acceptBody: The customer will be told you are available. Only accept if you can do the job at this time.
invitation.acceptedBody: The customer will now confirm. Once they book you, their contact details and address will appear in Bookings.
invitation.withdrawnBody: This job was given to someone else or cancelled by the customer.
invitation.goneTitle: This job is no longer available
invitation.goneBody: It has expired or another provider was chosen. New jobs will appear on the Jobs tab.

booking.title: Booking

confirm.startBody: Only start when you have reached the customer.
confirm.completeBody: The customer will be asked to confirm and review.
confirm.cancelBody: Cancelling often affects your rating and future jobs.

booking.cancelHint: Please tell the customer why. They will see this reason.
booking.cancelReasonError: Please write a reason (at least 5 letters).
booking.startOpensAt: You can start this job from {{time}}.

profile.previewHint: This is how customers see you.
profile.noPreview: Your public profile appears once a service is approved.

validation.minBooking: Choose the shortest job you will take.
validation.qualificationTitle: Enter a title or remove this item.
validation.location: Set the centre of your work area.
validation.availabilityTypes: Pick at least one kind of work.
validation.dayParts: Pick at least one time of day.

validation.timeOrder: The end time must be after the start time.
